full_name: Veterans Affairs Low-Vision Visual Functioning Questionnaire-48 (Italian version)
domains: reading; visual motor; mobility; visual information (subscales, abstract p1)
scoring: mean of raw item scores (1 to 5) overall and by subscale; also IRT Graded Response Model latent trait (Stata irt grm) (p2)
validation_method: CTT; internal consistency; criterion validity; IRT
target_population: adults 18+ attending low vision rehabilitation services
notes: Cronbach alpha 0.98; median item-test r 0.73 (IQR 0.67-0.77), item-rest 0.71 (abstract p1, p3); 11 items need rephrasing, 10 items >25% missing (p3-4); administered as interview by trained psychologists; Rasch not used (p5); original questionnaire developed by Stelmack (p2)
